page.overview:
Who is Tate & Liza?

Tate and Liza are the multi-battling -type twin Gym Leaders at Mossdeep City's Gym in the Hoenn region. Since they cooperate as the Gym Leaders of Mossdeep City, all battles against Tate and Liza are Double Battles.

Due to being twins, Tate and Liza are almost identical appearance-wise. They both appear to be little kids with dark blue hair, fair skin, and gray eyes. Their clothes are also identical (save for two colored stars on their chests) and resemble clothing worn by Chinese Shaolin monks. They both sport a pair of white ribbons in their hair. However, to tell the difference between the two of them, Liza has two pigtails, while Tate does not.

Tate and Liza wear pink-outlined light blue outfits with Poké Ball logos on their chests and on their biceps. They also wear blue shoes with pink outlines.

Tate and Liza wear an outfit that consists of a puffy-sleeved white and blue shirt with two stars on it and black cuffs, matching blue pants with a planet-like symbol on the thighs, and blue flats. The only difference is the two stars on their chests- Tate has green stars, while Liza has magenta ones.
